representativeExamples.note: Page example (illustrative, 'khoảng' amounts, shown at the best rate): first instalment ~1,817,000 VND (principal 1,667,000 + interest 150,000), last ~1,679,000, total interest ~975,000. monthlyPaymentVnd is the FIRST instalment only; instalments fall each month. Arithmetic checks out: interest = 20,000,000 x 0.75% x 13 / 2 = 975,000, total 20,975,000. The 0.75%/month rate is about one-fifth of the official new-customer rate (45-55%/year), so treat as a marketing example, not a fixture.

researchNotes:
LICENSING: Home Credit is on data/licensed-institutions.json (licence 90/GP-NHNN). Legal name on the company's own contract and footer: Công ty Tài chính TNHH Một thành viên Home Credit Việt Nam, MST 0307672788, Ho Chi Minh City.
OWNERSHIP: no rename found; site footer and the Ver05.2026 contract use the same name. Secondary news only (low confidence, dates unreliable): Home Credit Group agreed to sell 100% of the Vietnam unit to SCB/SCBX of Thailand for over EUR 800 million, and the deal was reportedly cancelled (around March 2026). Not verified at an official source; it does not affect the licence.
MAJOR CONTRADICTION (cash loan rate): the product page advertises 'từ 0,75%/tháng (dư nợ giảm dần)' = 9%/year. The company's rate-disclosure sheet effective 21/07/2026 says new customers pay 45%-55%/year reducing balance (existing customers 16,22%-49,50%). The headline is about one-fifth of the official new-customer minimum. The sheet is used for offered_range; 0.75% is stored only as advertised_floor and as a low-confidence example. The rate sheet is a scanned image (read visually 2026-11-01); it could not be machine-read on 2026-11-02.
AMOUNT: the cash-loan page advertises up to 250M VND, above the 100M finance-company cap (Circular 43/2016 art. 3(1)); recorded as a conflict for a lawyer.
REDUCING vs FLAT: cash loan is reducing balance (sheet and page agree), repaid in equal principal per the page example. Motorbike homepage tile says flat 0.55%/month but the product page says only 'từ 0%'; electronics page states no basis.
CONTRACT TEMPLATE (cash loan, Ver05.2026, effective 22/05/2026; scanned images read visually, pages 1-3 and 5 of 8 only): rate, early-repayment % and overdue-interest % are blank per customer; overdue principal interest = 150% of in-term rate; early repayment needs lender consent, a minimum number of paid instalments, 1 day notice, and the early-repayment fee as % of outstanding principal; insurance premium can be financed inside the loan principal and paid directly to the insurer; borrower pays third-party transfer or cash-withdrawal fees; cash loan contract cannot be cancelled after disbursement. Pages 4, 6-8 not read, so any late fee or collection fee there is unknown.
INSURANCE: optional Gói An tâm Tài chính is offered at loan registration (FAQ); the rate sheet lists a separate loan 'cho vay để thanh toán phí bảo hiểm' at 16,22%-55%/year reducing, so premiums can be financed. Whether any loan makes insurance mandatory, the premium, and deducted-vs-added treatment are not stated publicly (hotline 1900 633 633); 'added_to_loan' is inferred from the contract structure.
TRANSFER FEE: 11,000 VND mapped to 'Phí chuyển tiền' from a merged cell shared with the early-repayment row; layout ambiguity, medium confidence.
GAPS: late fee amounts, overdue-interest rate, early repayment %, collection-point fees (FAQ lists collection points, no fee stated), minimum income, motorbike and electronics rate basis, credit card figures, Home PayLater (homepaylater.vn, BNPL, 1-12 months, 0% promo for 1-3 months), Big Ticket and entrusted-loan contracts not collected. Online flag left null: the homepage says cash loans are online, but its application process lists visiting a branch.
RANKING: only the cash loan is ranked; electronics, motorbike and card products are excluded (marketing pages, no offered range, no fees).
